recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.method: Mix the ingredients and cook in a frying pan.

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs
recipes.method: Beat the eggs with milk. Melt butter in a pan and cook while stirring.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.method: Boil the spaghetti. Cook the beef and onion, then add tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Sandwich
recipes.method: Cook the chicken and place it between bread with lettuce and mayonnaise.

recipes.name: Fruit Salad
recipes.method: Wash and chop the fruit. Mix everything together in a bowl.
